answer: Anchor each identity to one physical SIM card: the network texts a fresh one-time code to the registered number every epoch, and the reply must come from that SIM within minutes. A carrier plan is the lagoon - wide, slow to cross, and one SIM floats exactly one identity. A farm wanting a hundred votes must buy a hundred plans, each with carrier KYC and a monthly bill, while a violet-flagged number that answers for two identities is burned with its stake. Honest users wander through one text a day; the Sybil operator pays a hundred subscriptions and a hundred KYC trails, with no bulk discount.
